## ADR-0096 implemented — closing as completed ✅

All task-breakdown items (D0–D7) plus two runtime follow-ups have merged to `main`. ADR status is **Accepted**, and the acceptance criterion holds end-to-end: an AI-authorable, provider-bound `connectors:` instance is materialized at boot and dispatched by a flow `connector_action`; boot fails loudly on unknown provider / invalid providerConfig / unresolvable credentialRef / name conflict.

| Item | Delivered by |
|---|---|
| **D0** — ADR review & acceptance (Proposed → Accepted) | #2994 |
| **D1** — Schema evolution (`@objectstack/spec`): `provider` / `providerConfig` / `auth.credentialRef`, inline-secret rejection, `.describe()` for AI authoring | #2994 |
| **D2** — Provider factory registration surface wired into the automation engine | #2994 |
| **D3** — Boot materialization + `credentialRef` resolution (`CredentialResolver`, env-var default resolver) | #2994 |
| **D4** — Conflict rule (origin-tagged registration; cross-origin name collision = loud boot failure) | #2994 |
| **D5** — Provider implementations: `connector-rest` / `connector-openapi` / `connector-mcp` factories | #2994 |
| **D6** — Showcase upgrade: live `provider: 'rest'` instance dispatched by a flow `connector_action`; surfaced by `GET /connectors` | #2994 |
| **D7** — Open/enterprise line documented (static auth + env `credentialRef` open; managed vault / OAuth2 / per-tenant lifecycle enterprise) | #2994, objectstack-ai/cloud#839 |
| **F1** — Runtime re-materialization: boot **and** `metadata:reloaded` reconcile (signature-diff add / teardown / re-materialize; boot fatal, reload soft) | #3001 |
| **F2** — objectui: flow-designer connector picker reads the runtime registry (`GET /api/v1/automation/connectors`) and annotates `· declarative` | objectstack-ai/objectui#2563 |

### Deferred as follow-up enhancements (tracked as sub-issues)
Two refinements found during implementation, both beyond the D0–D7 scope:
- #3016 — `connector-openapi`: resolve `providerConfig.spec` from a **file path** (currently inline spec objects only).
- #3017 — `connector-mcp`: **non-fatal / lazy boot** for an unreachable MCP server (unblocks a live `provider: 'mcp'` showcase demo).

### Release
Version bumps for the touched packages (`@objectstack/{spec,service-automation,connector-rest,connector-openapi,connector-mcp}` → `15.1.0`) are queued in the Changesets release PR #2954.

Closing as **completed**.
